items.title: ETHGas [GWEI] surges 38% after Coinbase listing slump – Is $0.064 next?
items.whyYouShouldCare: The surge in ETH gas fees indicates increased network activity, which could impact Solana's positioning as a faster, cheaper alternative for transactions.

items.whyYouShouldCare: Samsung Wallet's integration of stablecoins could enhance liquidity and usage in the crypto ecosystem, potentially benefiting Solana's adoption among its 800 million users.

items.title: EU expands HTX crackdown as Russia-linked crypto network keeps shifting its financial rails
